elements.manual_reason: The right-side 'Situation' bullet text column exits the frame and is absent in the end frame, so no candidate box covers it.
elements.label: Situation bullet column (exiting)

pattern.description: A split layout (dashboard screenshot left, 'Situation' bullets right) reframes into a single centred hero: the dashboard window scales up about 11% and drifts right to centre while the bullet column slides off the right edge.
pattern.why_premium: The reframe keeps the same UI object on screen rather than cutting, so the viewer's attention carries over from the narrative bullets straight into the product; a fast-start, long-tail ease-out makes it feel settled, not mechanical.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.timeline().to('.dashboard', {scale: 1.11, xPercent: 6, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out'}, 0).to('.situation-bullets', {xPercent: 120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.in'}, 0); transform-origin centre, single move, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); dashboard style transform: `translateX(${interpolate(p,[0,1],[0,70])}px) scale(${interpolate(p,[0,1],[1,1.11])})`; bullets translateX interpolate(p,[0,1],[0,400]) with opacity fading to 0; critically damped, no overshoot.

notes: Camera verdict is 'none'; the scale 1.11 and pan_x describe the dashboard element growing inside the frame, not a camera move. The burst begins mid-motion (energy peaks at the first frame), so the reframe likely started before 17.73s. Exiting bullet column uses a manual box at its former position.
